decisions.reason: Selecting concept 4 and requesting visual refinements does not change the already fulfilled obligation to provide an initial logo concept set.
The source changes the logo's color and letterform treatment but does not change the required business name, strapline text, or exclusion of the word 'truck'.
The selected design direction and typography refinements do not alter the requirement that the artwork be fresh and original.
The source selects a graduated color treatment for the logo but does not change the separate obligation to establish and supply brand color documentation.
